$comment: Caption style presets ported from Adits shared/smart-captions.js _renderStyled() and shared/active-tracking-captions.js (style switch near line 1737). Colors, pills and glows are Adits' values. Fonts are mapped to HyperFrames' bundled families so renders need no font download; the Adits original is kept in aditsFont. 'flash' reproduces Adits' per-word flash (flashAlpha = 1 on a new word, x0.80 per 60 fps frame) as a seekable decay: scale = 1 + flash * flashScale, glow blur = glow + flash * flashGlow.

karaoke.$note: Adits karaoke pulses the pill on each word. The active-word highlight inside a phrase is an addition for line/phrase mode.

kinetic.$note: Adits kinetic scatters each word with Math.random(); here positions come from a seeded PRNG and are clamped to the 9:16 safe box.

collage.$note: Style pack tactile-collage (library/styles/tactile-collage). Ported from github.com/audrey-560/hyperframes-tactile-collage tactile-caption.html: sheet card, 4 px ink edge, hard offset shadow, -1 deg tilt, active word in the primary accent. Fonts are files from the style pack, copied into the job.

editorial.$note: Style pack quiet-editorial (library/styles/quiet-editorial). Ported from github.com/audrey-560/quiet-editorial-ui quiet-editorial-caption.html card mode: Inter 700 on a warm near-white card, hairline border, soft shadow, rise in and lift out, no flash. Emphasis words use upright EB Garamond (no bundled italic).

vox.$note: Style pack vox-parallax. From the user's Vox reference Short: short uppercase phrases in a bold condensed sans, white on a dark warm rounded pill, no pop. Oswald (bundled) stands in for the condensed face.

mp-body.$note: Style pack marketing-pro. From the user's reference ad (Video-2306): a two-tier body caption at chest height, the clause's lead words small and light above, bold rolling 1-2 word chunks below, each blurring in and out. Inter (bundled).

mp-body-dark.$note: mp-body for light backgrounds (a white wall or shirt behind the chest): dark text with a soft light halo. The marketing-pro planner picks it from the sampled background.

editorial-clean.$note: quiet-editorial clean mode: unboxed ink on a quiet, high-contrast ground (the warm canvas or a clean wall). Use 'editorial' over busy footage.

split-seam.$note: style-split-screen-edit: the small caption on the seam between the B-roll panel and the presenter panel (reference Video-94146, measured: about 26 px on 720 wide, centred near 64% of the height). 1-3 words, white, soft shadow; the seam is kept dark by the fade and shade, so no box.

split-pill.$note: style-split-screen-edit: the seam caption over full-frame B-roll and white cards, on a dark rounded pill (the reference switches to the pill over light backgrounds).

info-chip.$note: Style pack info-graphics: one spoken word at a time, white Inter on a small near-black chip, low centre (--y 1440), no pop and no colour change, as in the user's video-essay reference Short.

negative.$comment: The look --negative forces on any preset (user rule, 2026-10-09: the inverted text must be easy to read). A difference blend inverts by the text colour, so pure white gives the strongest inversion. Pills, strokes, glows and shadows are dropped: under the blend they become a tinted box or a smear. The preset's face is kept when it has a heavy cut (heavyFonts: family -> the weight to use), otherwise the text is set in font/weight. Sizes grow by sizeScale unless --size is given. Place it behind the subject (--behind <pnp>), so only the background inverts.

deferred.motion3d: Adits _handleMotion3DCanvas: 3D canvas transform per phrase (Phase 3, with camera moves)
deferred.fisheye: Adits fisheye warp through an offscreen canvas (Phase 6 pre-pass)
deferred.flow: active-tracking lyric styles flow / instagram / stack / spotlight / wave / carousel / kinetic_impact (later phase)
